title: services.categories.create
description: Payload of commands/category_create.sql. `hub_id`, `new_id`, `current_user_id` and `now` are injected by the runtime (§2.5). Only `name` is required; the slug is derived from the id when omitted, the rest default in the statement. Closed contract (services#9).

slug.description: URL-safe key, unique per hub (`uq_*_hub_slug`): lowercase, no spaces. Empty/null = derived by the statement/handler.

parent_id.description: Parent category of THIS hub, alive, or none (root). The statement checks ownership and liveness and refuses with `services.parent_category_unavailable`; a category cannot be its own parent (CHECK).
